title: Meeting Rooms
description:
Given an array of meeting time intervals `intervals`, where `intervals[i] = [start, end]` means a meeting runs from `start` up to (but not including) `end`, determine whether one person can **attend all of the meetings**.

Two meetings conflict if they overlap; one that ends exactly when another starts does not conflict.
hints: Sort the meetings by start time.
After sorting, you only need to compare each meeting with the one before it.
